title: Release history labels
description: A country's labels.json (`release_history/cli.py`, `labels_document`): what the page shows for each reform. Replaceable, so a corrected label needs no new panel; finalize copies it into every timeline. Version 1: every key listed here is required and no other key is allowed. A key added later is declared here with the version that added it, and is not required, so the documents already written stay valid and no format version moves.

source.description: Where the reform is defined, as the spec gives it.
